summary: Computes an audio buffer load ratio and passes it to a stored callback. Returns 0 immediately if the callback pointer dword_8B8F00 is null. Otherwise dispatches on buffer state dword_8B8EF8: case 1 computes (1 - dword_8B8EE8/dword_8B8EF0) * 20.0, case 2 computes (1 - Addend/dword_8B8EF4) * 80.0 + 20.0; both clamp to return 0 when the value is below 0.25, else pass the float to the callback. Case 3 passes literal 1120403456 to the callback. Default returns 0.

local_names.v3: float copy of v1 passed to callback

operations.description: If dword_8B8F00 (callback pointer) is null, return 0 immediately.
Dispatch on dword_8B8EF8 (buffer ready state) via jump table jpt_545F6C with cases 1, 2, 3 and a default.
Case 1: if v1 < 0.25, return 0; otherwise fall through to the callback invocation.
Case 2: if v1 < 0.25, return 0; otherwise fall through to the callback invocation.
Cases 1 and 2: v3 = v1, then invoke the callback dword_8B8F00(0, LODWORD(v3)).
Return 0 after a handled case (result = 0); default case also returns 0.
